questions.question: Describe your experience preparing or reviewing income tax returns for individuals and businesses. What types of returns have you worked on, and what was your level of responsibility?

At Macquarie Group and Beauty First, you handled sales and use tax activities. Walk me through your process for determining use-tax accruals, filing or remitting taxes, and reconciling the related accounts.
You developed a new strategy for collecting and reporting monthly sales taxes at Macquarie Group. What problem were you solving, how did you implement the strategy, and what results did it produce?

This role requires accounting closings and year-end adjustments using procedural checklists. Describe your month-end or year-end close responsibilities, including journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, and documentation.
Tell me about your experience reconciling balance-sheet accounts. How do you investigate reconciling items and ensure the final support is accurate and complete?
You have worked with JDE, CAMS, SAP, AS400, and Microsoft Office. Which systems did you use most extensively, and how have you used Excel or other tools to improve accounting workflows or reporting?

Describe a time you worked with auditors or responded to an audit request, such as the sales-tax audits at Macquarie Group. How did you organize support, resolve questions, and follow through on findings?

In your Southern Company role, you tracked capital projects and asset additions. How did you ensure spending remained within budget and that completed projects were appropriately documented and recorded as fixed assets?
This position involves leading tax and accounting projects and supporting staff. Tell me about your experience training associates or accounting assistants on new procedures, policies, or systems.

Our firm works with multiple clients in a fast-paced, paperless, deadline-driven environment. How do you organize competing accounting and tax deadlines, maintain documentation, and communicate status or issues to managers and clients?
